title: Prototype-Rule Neurosymbolic Regularization for Rank-Constrained Tensor Neural Networks under Label Scarcity
abstract: arXiv:2609.40131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rank-constrained tensor neural networks reduce the parameterization of high-order inputs, but they do not explicitly constrain class geometry in the learned representation. This study investigates whether a differentiable prototype-rule can provide a complementary inductive bias for Rank-R tensor learning under limited supervision. The proposed framework augments the Rank-R objective with prototype-based regularization and optionally fuses prototype evidence with neural logits at inference. Four hyperspectral benchmarks are evaluated with four Rank-R configurations under both seven-fold stratification and spatially separated folds that mitigate leakage; a separate spatial study varies the class support budget from 2 to 20 samples. Under spatial evaluation, full neurosymbolic inference changes Macro-F1 score by +8.82 percentage points on Botswana, +5.49 on Indian Pines, +1.59 on Pavia University, and -0.62 on Salinas. Most of the benefit

translated_title: 标签稀缺条件下面向秩约束张量神经网络的原型规则神经符号正则化
translated_abstract: 秩约束张量神经网络降低了高阶输入的参数化规模，但并未显式约束学习表示中的类别几何结构。本研究探讨可微原型规则能否在有限监督下为Rank-R张量学习提供一种互补的归纳偏置。所提出的框架在Rank-R目标函数中加入基于原型的正则化，并可选择在推理阶段将原型证据与神经网络logits进行融合。研究在七折分层划分和可缓解信息泄漏的空间分离折两种评估设置下，使用四种Rank-R配置对四个高光谱基准数据集进行评估；此外还开展了一项独立的空间实验，将每类的支持样本预算从2个变化到20个。在空间评估下，完整的神经符号推理使Macro-F1分数在Botswana上提升8.82个百分点，在Indian Pines上提升5.49个百分点，在Pavia University上提升1.59个百分点，在Salinas上下降0.62个百分点。大部分收益……
tldr: 该研究提出一种可微原型规则的神经符号正则化方法，在标签稀缺场景下为秩约束张量神经网络提供类别几何约束，在高光谱图像空间评估中最高带来8.82个百分点的Macro-F1提升。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces differentiable prototype-rule neurosymbolic regularization for rank-constrained tensor neural networks under label scarcity, achieving up to +8.82 percentage points in Macro-F1 on spatially evaluated hyperspectral benchmarks.
